title: CLIVE stops saying returns are not available: the returns stub's four NOT_IMPLEMENTED rows are retired, and CROOKS Returns and every Shopify-return guard stay
requested_outcome:
MAP.md's Parked row 'The returns stub' (decision: delete; expires 19 Oct). app/families/returns.py registers four capability families from app/returns/contract.py: Taking an item back (return_create), Swapping an item (return_exchange), Sending a replacement (replacement_item) and Sending it again (resend_shipment). Each is NOT_IMPLEMENTED, with 'the scope is not granted and the reviewed mutation is not written'. They reach every model turn through app/routes/turn.py `_family_lines` ('[What CLIVE cannot do right now. Do not attempt these; say why if asked: ... NOT_IMPLEMENTED — ...: Sending a replacement (write_draft_orders), Sending it again (...), Taking an item back (write_returns), Swapping an item (write_returns)'), and they reach /health and the settings sheet. Since 3 October (DEC-066) returns and exchanges go through CROOKS Returns: returns_open, return_find, returns_stats and the staged return_action (app/tools/returns_tools.py), whose own families ('Reading returns', 'Acting on returns') say whether CLIVE can use them. So CLIVE tells the owner, and itself, that returns are not available while it can act on them.

Change:
(1) app/families/returns.py registers nothing. The build loop's builder cannot delete a file, so it becomes a module holding only its header and no code or import. The header says the four rows it registered were retired because returns and exchanges go through CROOKS Returns (DEC-066), whose families say what CLIVE can do; that no family is registered here; and that the file is kept only until it is deleted.
(2) app/returns/contract.py's code does not change, and its contract tests in tests/test_returns.py stay and pass. Its module docstring and app/returns/__init__.py's say that nothing registers the four as capability families any more and that the contract is kept until it is deleted. They no longer say the capability state the owner sees is in app/families/returns.py. Nothing else in those two files changes.
(3) experience/scenario_packs/anticipation.py `returns_are_not_available_yet`: its two checks that each of the four rows is NOT_IMPLEMENTED and names its scope become one check per key that the families table has no row for it. Its three Shopify-return guard checks stay exactly as they are: 'the only tools named for returns are CROOKS Returns' own', 'no Shopify return mutation is registered at all', and 'no reviewed Shopify mutation document touches a return'. So does `shopify_return_documents`. The function and the scenario keep the name returns_are_not_available_yet, because tests/test_crooks_returns.py's guard test calls it by that name and must not change. Its Result title and docstring say what it checks now: a return goes through CROOKS Returns and never through Shopify.
(4) tests/test_returns.py: exactly two tests are removed, test_the_four_rows_say_not_implemented_and_name_the_scope_to_grant and test_the_rows_carry_the_mutation_and_the_verification_for_whoever_builds_it. Each tests only the family registration deleted in (1). Every other test in that file stays byte for byte, test_no_return_mutation_is_registered_anywhere first among them, and so does the module docstring.
(5) A new crooks-assistant/tests/test_returns_stub_retired.py proves it.

Must not change: tests/test_returns.py::test_no_return_mutation_is_registered_anywhere, or any other guard that no Shopify return, exchange, reverse-delivery or reverse-fulfilment mutation is registered or reviewed (tests/test_crooks_returns.py, the scenario's three guard checks). Also unchanged: CROOKS Returns' tools, client, views (app/returns/views.py), routes, cards, families and keys, and the hold on its money actions; app/clients/shopify.py; app/capabilities/families.py and every other family; the system prompt and `_family_lines`; and the Easyship stub (app/families/shipping.py, app/shipping/), which belongs to another lane. Every assertion in tests/test_families.py, its per-turn size bound included, stays unchanged. No file is deleted and no tool is added. MAP.md is the Director's to update when this lands. docs/phase4/TOOL_MATRIX.md is regenerated by the loop: do not edit it. Run every declared check yourself with the run_checks tool, exactly as declared, before you report, and report only a candidate on which all of them pass. If a check fails on the untouched base, report that base failure and its output instead of changing anything to hide it. You cannot delete files or run commands other than the declared checks. Do not report an owner decision for GitHub acceptance: it runs automatically on your published candidate.
acceptance_criteria: After app.families.load_all(), with app.tools.returns_tools imported, app.capabilities.families.get() is None and families.states(None) has no row for each of return_create, return_exchange, replacement_item and resend_shipment (check: tests).

The per-turn block that app/routes/turn.py `_family_lines` builds from that table contains none of 'Taking an item back', 'Swapping an item', 'Sending a replacement', 'Sending it again' or 'write_returns', and the CROOKS Returns families ('Reading returns', 'Acting on returns') are still in the table with the state they have today (check: tests).
app/families/returns.py contains no import and no code, only its header; app/returns/contract.py's code is unchanged (review; check: tests runs tests/test_returns.py's contract tests).

tests/test_returns.py differs from trunk only by the two removed tests named in the request; every remaining test, test_no_return_mutation_is_registered_anywhere included, passes unchanged (check: tests).
The golden scenario returns_are_not_available_yet passes, and its three Shopify-return guard checks and `shopify_return_documents` are unchanged (check: golden).

tests/test_families.py, tests/test_connections_page.py, tests/test_connections_routes.py, tests/test_no_dangling_imports.py, tests/test_registry.py and the other neighbouring suites pass unchanged (check: regression).
ruff passes on app, config, scripts, tests and experience/scenario_packs/anticipation.py (check: ruff).
